title: ElasticDino: Dense Semantic Features Using Elastic Deformations
abstract: arXiv:2611.16984v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision transformers (ViTs) serve as the backbone for countless vision tasks, including dense prediction tasks, such as segmentation and depth estimation, even though the quadratic complexity of self-attention severely limits feature resolution and induces spatial artifacts. In this work, we introduce ElasticDino, a lightweight adapter which produces high-resolution feature maps, adhering to the fine details of the input image. As a key insight, we observe the consistency of artifacts across channels, and simultaneously resolve them to match the input image structure. Using a slim architecture based on spatial deformations, ElasticDino produces pixel-aligned, high-resolution feature maps efficiently. Leveraging deformations allows strictly preserving sharp semantics, and thereby avoiding the smoothness biases inherent to alternative approaches. translated_title: ElasticDino：利用弹性形变的稠密语义特征
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer（ViTs）是无数视觉任务的骨干网络，包括分割和深度估计等稠密预测任务，尽管自注意力的二次复杂度严重限制了特征分辨率并导致空间伪影。在这项工作中，我们提出了ElasticDino，一种能够生成高分辨率特征图、贴合输入图像精细细节的轻量级适配器。作为一个关键洞察，我们观察到伪影在各通道间具有一致性，并同时将其消除以匹配输入图像的结构。ElasticDino采用基于空间形变的精简架构，高效地生成像素对齐的高分辨率特征图。利用形变能够严格保留清晰的语义，从而避免了其他替代方法固有的平滑偏差。由于缺乏真值标注，我们采用像素级语义分割和深度估计来评估方法的有效性。
tldr: ElasticDino是一种轻量级适配器，通过空间弹性形变高效生成像素对齐的高分辨率特征图，在保留清晰语义的同时消除了视觉Transformer的空间伪影，可用于分割和深度估计等稠密预测任务。
en_tdlr: ElasticDino is a lightweight adapter that uses spatial elastic deformations to efficiently produce pixel-aligned, high-resolution feature maps, resolving the spatial artifacts of vision transformers while preserving sharp semantics for dense prediction tasks such as segmentation and depth estimation.
